turns.prompt_text: is beeswax for like skin wax for waxing
turns.response_html:
Beeswax is generally not for hair removal.

While it is a common ingredient in hair removal waxes to provide grip and consistency, pure beeswax is primarily used in skincare to lock in moisture and protect the skin. If you are looking to wax hair, you need a "body wax" or "hard wax" blend that contains resins to make it sticky enough to pull hair from the root.
